get.summary: Search verified official GAR settlements, independent of commercial service areas
get.description: Query text is not a saved address. Normalizes ё/е/case, prefixes, transliteration, keyboard layout and bounded typos. Completeness and exclusions are explicit in coverage. No request goes to DaData or Bitrix.

get.summary: Read one active verified Settlement ID

404.description: Settlement not in the active validated index

get.summary: Read session selection and bounded recent places
get.description: Old exact-unique official names may be inferred at version 0 with selectionSource=legacy-exact without a GET write. Ambiguous strings remain unselected. No physical DEFAULT_CITY override.

post.summary: Save an official Settlement ID with version and context checks
post.description: Atomically updates only session geography/compatibility label/recent choices and revokes unconsumed session quotes. Preserves every cart and historical order. No prices, warehouses, delivery or payment eligibility are fabricated.

post.summary: Closed integration boundary for regional cart validation
post.description: Currently never returns success: validates session/version/context and requires a selected settlement, then returns503 LOCATION_INTEGRATION_REQUIRED. Does not reprice a cart or create an order.

blocks.description: Hero первым; один immutable id на type. Нет URL/HTML/JSX. Unknown future type клиент пропускает.

oldPriceKopecks.description: Только из source snapshot, строго больше priceKopecks; иначе поле отсутствует.

discountPercent.description: Server integer projection of valid snapshot old/current price. Not a client price rule.

LocalSession.description: Opaque local session token from POST /api/sessions. This is not production user authentication.

x-integration-boundaries.procurement: Mobile ProcurementRequest contract is documented in docs/architecture/mobile-bff.md. No enabled HTTP submission/upload route is advertised before a verified source adapter exists.
x-integration-boundaries.organizations: Anonymous session has no organization membership. Old draft is retained, but public context toggle cannot grant business permissions.
